description: Every attempt of one test in one run - one Playwright project variant, by the name squally-get-run lists, project included - oldest first, each with the error, the stack and the full-context prompt (the same text Squally's Fix panel copies under Fix in your agent, Without MCP), and the test's annotations (an issue link, a skip or fixme reason), its line, worker and start time. This is the tool for 'why did this test fail'. If the test name is ambiguous, pass filePath.

filePath.description: The spec file of the test, as stored (e.g. tests/checkout.spec.ts); an empty value means a test with no file. Pass it exactly as shown in Squally; do not URL-encode, the server does. Needed only when the name exists in several files - the ambiguous_test error lists them.

runId.description: A run id from GET /projects/{projectId}/runs - or any shard's id of a sharded run.

testName.description: The test's name exactly as squally-get-run lists it - with its Playwright project when it has one, for example "chromium > checkout flow > completes payment": one project's variant, the way a run counts. Pass the name exactly as shown in Squally; do not URL-encode, the server does. A name used in several spec files also needs filePath.

name: squally-debug-failure

annotations.description: This attempt's annotations (Playwright's test.info().annotations), in the order they were added - at most 20. Empty when there are none, and for a result from a reporter before 0.19.0.

description.description: As the test wrote it, with secrets masked the way error text is; at most 1000 characters.

location.description: Where the annotation was added, file:line[:column]; null when Playwright did not say.

annotationsOmitted.description: How many annotations past the 20 the reporter did not send.

copyPrompt.description: A prompt for an assistant that has the repository open, byte-identical to the text that Copy prompt copies under Fix in your agent, Without MCP, on the attempt page. null for an attempt without a real failure (a pass, a test.fail() marker, no error text).

location.description: Where the test is declared in its file (Playwright's TestCase.location) - the file is filePath. null for a result from a reporter before 0.19.0.

parallelIndex.description: The worker's slot, 0 to workers - 1 (parallelIndex); a restarted worker keeps it. null for a result from a reporter before 0.19.0.

shard.description: The shard this attempt ran in; null for an unsharded run.

startedAt.description: When this attempt started. null for a result from a reporter before 0.19.0, and when the runner's clock put it more than a day before the run or in the future.

timedOut.description: Whether the attempt ended by running into its time limit (Playwright's timedOut). null when the reporter did not say - every result from a reporter before 0.10.0.

timeoutMs.description: The time limit Playwright applied to the attempt, in milliseconds; 0 means no limit. null when the reporter did not say.

workerIndex.description: The Playwright worker that ran this attempt (workerIndex). null for a result from a reporter before 0.19.0.

title: Debug a failing test
